human_authorization: Edit the user's fine-tuned BU model, rehost and test before Eden; total Modal credits ceiling USD30.
method: Exact recovered merged baseline W*. Candidate W_lambda = BF16(FP32(W*) + (lambda-1)*(alpha/r)*FP32(B@A)). Rebuild from immutable originals for every variant; lambda1 restores bytes directly. No gradient updates or paid teacher calls.
control_zero_interpretation: Adapter-subtracted merged checkpoint; NOT a verified raw BU base.
selection: Development task success first, then fewer invalid actions; retain baseline on tied success. Frozen acceptance is evaluated once for the selected candidate versus baseline, without subsequent tuning on acceptance results.
acceptance: More successful tasks than baseline and no new safety/schema failures; otherwise report no demonstrated improvement and do not promote.
limitations: Synthetic browser smoke tests do not establish Astra parity or general computer-use leadership.
Scaling an adapter tests adaptation strength, not transfer of a teacher's internal weights or broad intelligence.
Model architecture and total parameter count remain unchanged.
Original merged checkpoint and reconstructed base-plus-adapter are distinct until verified.
originals: Existing Modal volumes mount read-only. No overwrite or deletion of checkpoints. Realized patch statistics include BF16 rounding; edited matrices are rebuilt without cumulative changes.
performance_limitations: This first smoke test does not measure production throughput or a matched Astra baseline. Report startup separately and do not interpret warm-up/order effects as weight-induced speedups.
eden: Deferred; no Eden artifacts, datasets, models, runs, or gates are part of this experiment.
